title: ReferenceTrack
description: Header of the offline, NON-CAUSAL reference tip trajectory of one session (Phase 07, Task 07.2; reserved in docs/architecture/contracts.md section 6 and constrained by docs/architecture/causality-tests.md section 1.1). It is the first line of labels/<session>/tracks_reference.jsonl, followed by one ReferenceSample per line. The reference trajectory is smoothed with future frames and exists ONLY to construct labels: it is never written under records/, never a TrackState, never an input to any Tracker, Anticipator, feature, Geometry or CommitPolicy call, and never a model input or training feature. The CAUSAL track of the same session (tracks_causal.jsonl) is a normal TrackState stream and is the only trajectory a model may see.

kind.description: Not a record type: RecordStreamHeader.record_type cannot take this value, so a reference track cannot be opened as a record stream.

causal.description: Const false: the samples use future frames by design (the only place future information is permitted, causality-tests.md section 1).

method_id.description: Smoother identity (Task 07.2 candidates). The choice is a Decision That Must Be Experimentally Validated against manual tip annotations near impacts.

method_params.description: Exact parameters of the smoother; hashed into provenance.smoother_hash.

source_stream.description: Which recorded stream the smoother consumed (records/StickObservation.jsonl: the measurements, not the causal filter output).

gap_policy.description: Gaps shorter than max_gap_s are bridged by the smoother; longer gaps are NEG_TRACKING_LOSS intervals and carry no reference samples.

label.const: NON-CAUSAL OFFLINE LABEL SOURCE - never a model input

sample.title: ReferenceSample
sample.description: One smoothed sample of one hand: hand, frame reference, time on t_mono, position and velocity in ROI-normalized units. quality is the smoother posterior quality, not a TrackState confidence; the two are different estimators and are never compared. Samples of both hands share one file, each preceded by that hand's header line.
